summary: Core Scientific, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. The agreement establishes a $100.0 million senior secured revolving credit facility and a $500.0 million letter of credit facility, with no amounts drawn at closing. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR plus 1.75% or an alternate base rate plus 0.75%. The facilities mature three or four years after closing. This is a routine financing arrangement for working capital and project obligations, not a special situation.
